st: A Year of Floods and Fire
d: El Niño events of 2016 trigger everything from unprecedented floods to extreme droughts around the globe.

In 2017, local weather anomalies cause flooding and mudslides in South America, wildfires erupt in Europe and America, two deadly earthquakes strike Mexico, and record-breaking hurricanes batter the Caribbean.
America's deadliest tornado in 60 years tears through Joplin, Mo., wiping out 200 houses each minute.
A tornado tears a mile-wide path through the American town of Moore, Okla., destroying two schools while the pupils are inside.
A holiday cruise ship sails into a hurricane, terrifying 4,000 passengers as their cabins are plunged underwater.
Hurricane Patricia rips apart a Mexican holiday resort sending tourists fleeing for their lives.
Survivors endure the worst kind of physical and psychological pain after their plane crashes in the Andes.
A cargo ship becomes stranded 500 kilometers from shore with a cyclone approaching.
A train flies off the tracks and crashes into an Osaka, Japan, apartment building.
A flash flood traps seven cavers 100 meters below ground.
On 8 Oct 2005, a massive earthquake strikes Islamabad, Pakistan. Will a rescue team be able to save the people or will the earthquake claim more lives?
The 2011 Super Tornado carved a mile wide path of destruction through Joplin, Missouri.
